The '''Desert of Salma''', also known as the '''Salma Desert''', was a major desert on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It was a land of acid pools and dry lakes. It was located beyond the [[Yawari Cliffs]], and beyond the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]]-inhabited forest land. The most common residents of the desert were the [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]], who typically built their homes in tall mountains of rock.

Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Old Man (Dathomir)|Old Man]] of [[Aurilia]] was held in captivity in this desert.<ref name="SWG" />

In approximately [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], siblings [[Mace Towani|Mace]] and [[Cindel Towani]] enlisted the help of a group of Ewoks to form a caravan that would cross the desert and rescue their parents, who had been kidnapped by one of the Gorax, and were being held captive in his [[Forbidden Fortress of the Gorax|lair]]. The caravan succeeded in its mission.<ref name="Caravan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Desert of Salma first made its appearance in the made-for-television film ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]'', where it was generated from a matte image.
